concept.hr: U pojasu sumraka D-regija više ne guta signal, a F-regija ga još lomi daleko
concept.en: At twilight the D region is gone but the F region still bends HF signals far

summary.hr: Karta svijeta s danom, noći i pojasom sumraka. Pomiči datum i vrijeme ili pokreni dan: kada su dvije postaje zajedno na greyline?
summary.en: A world map with day, night and the twilight band. Move the date and time, or play the day: when do two stations share the grey line?

what.hr: Zamisao: aplet greyline.html s 50ohm.de (karta s danom, noći i pojasom sumraka). Preuzeta je samo ideja; ni kod ni tekst apleta nisu korišteni
what.en: The idea: the applet greyline.html on 50ohm.de (a map with day, night and the twilight band). Only the concept is taken; none of the applet's code or text is used

what.hr: Jednadžbe položaja Sunca (deklinacija, jednadžba vremena): NOAA Solar Calculator, prema J. Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, 2. izd. (1998), pogl. 7, 25 i 28
what.en: The Sun's position equations (declination, equation of time): the NOAA Solar Calculator, after J. Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, 2nd ed. (1998), ch. 7, 25 and 28

credits.by: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory; Jean Meeus

what.hr: Obrisi kopna na karti: Natural Earth 1:110m, Land (ne_110m_land, v5.1.2), zaokruženo na 0,1°
what.en: The land outlines on the map: Natural Earth 1:110m, Land (ne_110m_land, v5.1.2), rounded to 0.1°

changes.hr: Pretvoreno u nizove koordinata u desetinkama stupnja (land.js)
changes.en: Converted to coordinate arrays in tenths of a degree (land.js)
